_meta.description: A finding where the primary RS documentation is complete (lot, CoA, IR, working standard, source all present) but the impurity standard is mentioned without an assigned purity value. The QA/Critic rules R4–R6 operate on text keywords only and cannot detect the missing structured field — this scenario confirms R4–R6 all pass despite the structural gap. The finding PASSes QA/Critic. This documents the known architecture limitation (G7): structured impurity standard completeness is enforced by s5_standards.py _check_completeness, not by qa_critic.py text-keyword rules.
_meta.rule_under_test: R4–R6 all pass (text keywords present); G7 architecture limitation documented
_meta.direction: POSITIVE for QA/Critic (PASS); structured gap detected upstream by s5_standards.py
_meta.iprp_reference: IPRP QWGG Guidance for Quality Assessors – Drug Substance, S.5, page 18. Assessment point (iv): impurity standard purity required.
_meta.author: M5

findings.rationale: Sponsor uses USP 47 Reference Standard for Compound Beta, lot number USP-CB-2024-R220. Certificate of analysis (CoA) submitted. Overlaid IR spectra submitted confirming identity. Working standard WS-CB-023 qualified against the USP primary reference standard. Source: purchased from United States Pharmacopeia. An impurity standard for Beta-Impurity-2 is referenced but no assigned purity value is stated in the submission.
findings.evidence_snippet: Lot no. USP-CB-2024-R220. CoA submitted. IR spectra overlaid. Working standard WS-CB-023 traceability confirmed. Source: USP. Impurity standard Beta-Impurity-2 referenced; purity not stated.

findings.note: QA/Critic text-keyword rules R4–R6 all pass: lot number, CoA, IR spectra, working standard, and source keywords are all present. The missing impurity standard purity (IPRP assessment point iv) is a structured-field gap detected by s5_standards.py _check_completeness, not by qa_critic.py. This is the documented G7 architecture limitation: QA/Critic is a last-line text check only.
